reading_note: The teaching describes envy — the inmost quality of self-love — as the originating nature of all evil. Self-love (Hyle/Matter) cannot generate genuine spiritual form; it can only counterfeit what it perceives in the divine. The arc traces this counterfeiting through four ascending registers: against the divine truth first sent (First Man), against the awakening call (Ambassador), against the regenerate human (Adam), and finally against celestial good itself (Christ and his Righteousness). At each stage, self-love beholds a divine image and molds a fleshly imitation of it — producing the natural-external man as a counterfeit garment. The conclusion: envy is the enthumesis of death, the very faculty in self-love by which it severs itself from the Living One.
